tagline: San Francisco as the default X11 font
description:
Makes **San Francisco**, Apple's system typeface, the default font for X11 apps on your jailbroken device, and makes the rest of the built-in iOS fonts (emoji, CJK, and so on) available too.

No font files are copied. It points the font system at iOS's own `/System/Library/Fonts`, so it always matches the OS and there's nothing to license or update.

- Default sans-serif, serif, and UI font: **San Francisco**
- Default monospace font: **SF Mono**
- Refreshes the font cache on install

Useful for anything that draws text in X11 apps (terminals, GTK/Qt apps, window managers). Built for iPadOS/iOS rootless (palera1n/Dopamine, `/var/jb`).

changelog.notes:
- Point fontconfig at /System/Library/Fonts (no fonts copied)
- San Francisco as default sans/serif/system-ui; SF Mono as default monospace
- fc-cache rebuilt on install
